name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-goal-orb
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Goal Orb
description:
Made an alternative to SMW Redrawn's orb graphic in order to look more faithful to the OG SMW's. The OG SMW version looked like a magic crystal orb and I wanted to restore that texturing with my own attempt while in the vein of SMW Redrawn's art style.

Included is "orb scrapyard.bin" which is various alternative attempts I made if you prefer to use those instead. Make sure you paste it to your respective GFX05.bin file.

Give credit if used.
